name: Pocket Giant

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} appears in the new still only once, as a tiny person ten centimetres tall, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The tiny {subject} stands on a wooden café table next to a white coffee cup that is as tall as {their} shoulders, wearing {wardrobe}, facing the camera, a croissant and a metal spoon lying beside {them} like giant objects. The rest of the café is softly blurred behind, warm and cozy. Macro close-up at table level, shallow depth of field, the tiny {subject} sharp and centered, full body visible. Cinematic macro photography, warm window light from the left. Correct human anatomy at a tiny scale, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the tiny {subject}, a plain unbranded cup throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame.
